exposure: Pharmacist preparation of drug solutions for postoperative analgesia
cohort: The study surveyed 51 anesthesiologists (44 responses) in the Department of Surgery at Chiba University Hospital regarding pharmacist-prepared drug solutions.
finding: Pharmacists' preparation of drug solutions for postoperative analgesia significantly reduced anesthesiologists' temporal and mental burden and anxiety, increased their reassurance, and resulted in high satisfaction, thus improving the quality and safety of medical care.
cross-section timing: After pharmacists began preparing drug solutions for postoperative analgesia (from May 2014)
